_about: The request to the certifying agency for the U visa certification (src/u_certification.py): the office's letter and Form I-918 Supplement B (01/20/25) with Part 1, the victim, filled (Supplement B Instructions: Parts 2-6 are the certifying official's). Nothing goes to USCIS, and none of the client's documents go with it. The attorney approves the letter.
title: U visa: certification request (Supplement B)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

u_cert_letter.title: Letter to the certifying agency asking for the certification

handwork.text: The letter: the attorney signs it.
The agency's address and its own procedure for certification requests (a unit, a form or a portal of its own): confirmed from the agency, never guessed.
Mail it with tracking and record the mailing: the case then shows the certification as requested.

When it comes back: the ORIGINAL with the official's ink signature (USCIS takes no photocopy of the signature page). Record the date it was signed: the petition must reach USCIS within six months of it.
